$comment: MCP connections for the agent. No secrets here: ${VAR} placeholders are
expanded from the process environment at connection time, so the Obsidian
Machine-specific overrides belong in config/mcp.local.json, which is ignored.
PROCUREMENT_MCP_PYTHON should point at the project virtualenv interpreter, e.g. .venv/bin/python.

obsidian.description: Approved existing server: bridge to the Obsidian Local REST API plugin. Reads the buyer watchlist and prior findings, writes the findings note back. Started via uvx with mcp pinned below 2.0: the published bridge is written against the 1.x SDK and crashes on import with 2.x.

procurement.description: Custom server in this repository: red-flag screening, concentration, threshold compliance and constrained retrieval over the prepared Prozorro dataset.
